title: Cancel Task
description: horch task cancel (request kind task_cancel). A policy also issues it inside fleetd for a replan that replaces the task and for the cancel or abandon of its idea or feature (A34).

request_id.description: The idempotency key that the horch CLI makes once per command run. The channel request, its retry and the request file of the same run carry the same request_id. fleetd applies a request once per request_id and returns the stored result again; a known request_id with a different payload hash is refused (A24).

operator_token.description: The operator token that horch reads from /fleet/run/operator.token (mode 0600). fleetd refuses an operator request with no valid token and records the refusal in its requests row. The sandbox of each worker denies reading the file (SR-8, A35).
